name: chatgpt-installation
description: ## Fool Your Friend 1. use conda to create a new environment called env-ssh ``` conda create -n env-ssh python=3.12 ``` 2. activate the new environment ``` conda activate env-ssh ``` 3. install the required packages ``` pip install -r requirements.txt ``` 4. set the environment variable ``` export GT_USERNAME=your_username export GT_PASSWORD=your_password export GT_DOMAIN=your_domain ``` 5. run the script ``` python3 run.py ```
